judge_reasoning: The model solution misapplies Brutal Expulsion's damage mode and Welding Sparks, both of which can only target creatures/planeswalkers, not the opponent directly, yet the model counts that damage as damage to the opponent. Additionally, the total mana required (10) exceeds the available mana sources (7 lands). The actual damage dealt directly to the opponent (Thermo-Alchemist activations + Shock) totals only 5, well short of the 10 needed to win. The solution is not rules-legal and does not achieve the objective.
model_solution:
1. Cast Stormchaser Mage
2. Tap Thermo-Alchemist for 1 damage
3. Cast Shock targeting opponent
4. Tap Thermo-Alchemist for 1 damage  
5. Cast Brutal Expulsion (damage mode only) targeting Indulgent Aristocrat
6. Tap Thermo-Alchemist for 1 damage
7. Cast Welding Sparks targeting Hinterland Drake for 5 damage

This deals 12 damage total (1+2+1+2+1+5), dealing lethal to the opponent who has 10 life.
